_note: Role catalog. Only roles that exist in public taxonomies or reports (O*NET codes, WEF Future of Jobs 2025 categories) or are common job-posting titles. kind='target' roles can be recommended; kind='current' roles are used to show the outlook of a user's present job. skills[].w: 1.0 = core, 0.5 = supporting, 0.25 = nice-to-have. SDG strength: 'direct' = the job's output delivers the target, 'enabling' = indirect contribution.

title.zh: 数据分析师 / BI 分析师

roles.summary: Turns business data into dashboards, reports and recommendations.
roles.hn: data analyst|bi analyst|business intelligence analyst|analytics engineer

sdgs.why: Produces timely, reliable data for decisions.
Data-driven decisions raise productivity.

roles.summary: Builds statistical and machine-learning models to predict and explain outcomes.

sdgs.why: Upgrades research and technological capability.
Improves the quality and use of data.

roles.summary: Designs, trains and deploys machine-learning systems in production.
roles.hn: machine learning engineer|\bml engineer|ai engineer|applied scientist

sdgs.why: Builds frontier technological capability.
AI systems raise productivity.

title.zh: 生成式 AI 应用开发者

roles.summary: Builds LLM-powered assistants, retrieval systems and AI agents into products.

sdgs.why: Builds national capability in a frontier technology.
AI assistants raise productivity.

roles.summary: Redesigns repetitive office workflows with RPA, low-code tools and AI assistants.

sdgs.why: Raises productivity through technological upgrading.
Shifts workers from repetitive tasks to higher-value work.

title.zh: 负责任 AI / AI 治理专员

roles.summary: Assesses AI systems for risk, fairness, privacy (PDPA) and compliance.

sdgs.why: Makes AI use in institutions accountable and transparent.
Fairness checks protect inclusion.

sdgs.why: Protects resilient digital infrastructure.
Keeps institutions' systems trustworthy.

roles.summary: Automates and runs reliable cloud infrastructure and delivery pipelines.

sdgs.why: Keeps digital infrastructure reliable.
Scales access to digital services.

roles.summary: Designs and builds web, mobile and back-end applications, increasingly with AI pair-programmers.

sdgs.why: Expands access to digital services.
Software raises productivity.

roles.summary: Researches users and designs usable, accessible digital products.

sdgs.why: Accessible design includes people with disabilities and low digital skills.
Usable products widen ICT access.

title.zh: 数字营销与增长分析师

title.zh: 太阳能光伏安装技术员

sdgs.why: Every installation raises the renewable share.
Creates decent green jobs accessible via TVET.

title.zh: 能源审计师 / 能源经理

roles.summary: Audits buildings and plants and runs energy-saving programmes.

sdgs.why: Directly improves energy efficiency.
Cuts emissions from buildings and industry.

title.zh: 可持续发展 / ESG 分析师

roles.summary: Measures emissions and prepares sustainability disclosures for companies.

sdgs.why: Integrates sustainability information into company reporting.
Turns climate targets into measured action.

title.zh: 电动汽车与电池系统技术员

roles.summary: Services electric vehicles, batteries and charging infrastructure.

sdgs.why: Cleaner urban air.
Cuts transport emissions.

roles.summary: Uses sensors, drones and geospatial data to raise yields with less water and fertiliser.

Supports early warning and health-risk management.

title.zh: 学习与发展专员 (AI 技能提升)

sdgs.why: Multiplies relevant skills for decent jobs.
Widens access to vocational learning at work.

roles.summary: Owns customer outcomes and relationships, supported by AI service tools.

title.zh: 对话式 AI 设计师

title.zh: 风险与合规分析师（反洗钱/KYC）

title.zh: 半导体测试与工艺工程师

title.zh: 内容策略师 / 社交媒体经理
